description.value: Kelowna Cycle, also known as 'The Hub,' is a full-service bicycle shop in Kelowna carrying road, mountain, gravel, commuter, and electric bikes from brands including Cannondale, Rocky Mountain, Norco, and Moustache. Their in-house Hub Bike Service department handles tune-ups and repairs across all bike types. The shop also stocks a comprehensive inventory of parts, accessories, and cycling apparel, making it a well-equipped resource for touring cyclists passing through the Okanagan.
